title: Monster Hunter: World
japaneseTitle: モンスターハンター：ワールド
shortDescription: Capcom's revolutionary global modernization of their beloved hunting franchise, introducing seamless living ecosystems and fluid 14-weapon combat.
historicalSignificance: Became the single best-selling video game in Capcom's 40-year corporate history with over 25 million units sold, successfully breaking a niche Japanese phenomenon into a worldwide cultural titan.

editorialContent.overview: Tasked by the Research Commission to sail to the untamed 'New World' during the Elder Crossing, hunters explore sprawling multi-tiered biomes to track, study, and defeat magnificent primordial wyverns and Elder Dragons.
editorialContent.gameplay: Pioneered seamless zones eliminating loading screens between map sectors, dynamic Turf Wars between predatory monsters, the versatile Slinger grapple, Scoutflies for tracking, and 14 deeply expressive weapon disciplines.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Built on Capcom's heavily modified MT Framework engine, simulating complex ecosystem food webs where monsters hunt, sleep, territory-mark, and actively prey upon each other.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Proved that demanding, high-skill action-RPG mechanics could achieve monumental mainstream success when paired with intuitive modern quality-of-life systems.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on physical Blu-ray discs and expanded with the massive Iceborne expansion.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 25 million copies sold worldwide (Capcom's all-time #1 bestseller)
awards: The Game Awards Best Role Playing Game 2018
